It is naturally occurring, organic compound that exists throughout much of nature but is predominantly found in cumin and thyme. Used as a flavoring, para-cymene can be found in cakes, beverages, and confections, and is also used for enhancing fragrances. Other manufactured goods that use para-cyceme include paints, furniture, and other consumer goods.
